headline: Additional benefits for prosumers in Vaslui who produce electricity with photovoltaic panels
summary: Prosumers in Vaslui producing electricity with photovoltaic panels will receive monthly compensation and can use their surplus. Outstanding amounts are to be paid within 40 days under new ANRE rules.
why: ANRE is Romania's energy regulator, and its rules set how households with solar panels are paid for power they feed into the grid.
